Select canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name. Source metabolism table. Join compound_structures on metabolism.substrate_record_id = compound_structures.molregno. Join molecule_dictionary on metabolism.drug_record_id = molecule_dictionary.molregno. Filter enzyme_name equals CYP2D6. Sort by canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name ascending. Limit 200.
